content: OCUFLOX® (ofloxacin ophthalmic solution) 0.3% is a sterile solution specifically designed for ophthalmic use. It is classified as a fluorinated carboxyquinolone anti-infective agent. The active ingredient in this solution is ofloxacin, present at a concentration of 0.3% (equivalent to 3 mg/mL). The chemical name of ofloxacin is (±)-9-Fluoro-2,3-dihydro-3-methyl-10-(4-methyl-1-piperazinyl)-7-oxo-7H-pyrido-1,4-benzoxazine-6-carboxylic acid. In addition to the active ingredient, the solution contains benzalkonium chloride at a concentration of 0.005% as a preservative. The inactive components include sodium chloride and purified water. Hydrochloric acid and/or sodium hydroxide may also be present in small amounts to adjust the pH of the solution. The formulation of OCUFLOX® is unbuffered and has a pH of 6.4, with an acceptable range between 6.0 and 6.8. Ofloxacin belongs to the class of fluorinated 4-quinolones. It is structurally distinct from other fluorinated 4-quinolones due to the presence of a six-membered pyridobenzoxazine ring that spans positions 1 to 8 of its core molecular structure.
